item.title: Rallying Cry – June 12, 2026
item.description: A million young people will get protection from meningitis B, Singapore’s Mandai Wildlife Reserve opens a cutting-edge animal hospital, and the DR Congo’s 2026 World Cup team is finally cleared to compete in the US—plus, lupus patients are seeing breakthroughs with a revolutionary immune reset.
